heading: Thursday, January 23, 2025
topLine: OpenAI introduces Computer-Using Agent model with Operator.

items.headline: OpenAI introduces Computer-Using Agent model with Operator
items.summary: OpenAI introduced Computer-Using Agent, a model combining GPT-4o vision with reinforcement-learned reasoning to operate a browser via screenshots, mouse and keyboard; it powers the Operator research preview for US Pro users. OpenAI reported 38.1% on OSWorld and 58.1% on WebArena.
